abstract: Pursuant to the Congressional Review Act, this document withdraws a disapproved final rule that was published in the Federal Register on December 23, 2024. The final rule would have established amended energy conservation standards for walk-in coolers and walk-in freezers.
dates: As of May 20, 2025, the final rule on energy conservation standards for walk-in coolers and walk-in freezers, published in the Federal Register on December 23, 2024, at 89 FR 104616, and delayed at 90 FR 13054 (Mar. 20, 2025), is withdrawn.
